root_cause.mechanism: the case runs protoc with -I . inside the taken-over package and no M-flag override, so protoc-gen-go derives the import of redact/v1/redact.proto from that file's own go_package option. The package copy still carried the upstream module path, and 627783c (T14) removed every github.com/tx7do require, so nothing can satisfy that import inside this module.
root_cause.regression_owner: this takeover programme, not the environment: 77898ac certified make tools-integration at exit 0 while the upstream module was still required, and T14 pruned it without re-running the protoc-driven entry (migration/receipts/T14.json only did go build -tags tools_integration).
root_cause.correction_of_an_earlier_claim: migration/receipts/T14.json recorded 'test fixtures and README/sample-proto text mention upstream paths as data only'. For these fixtures that is false: the go_package string is consumed by protoc and decides whether the generated code compiles.
root_cause.correction_of_the_T13_pass: with the upstream module still in the graph, verify_code_compiles resolved github.com/tx7do/.../redact/v1 to the module cache, so the certified green run compiled the generated code against the UPSTREAM runtime package and did not exercise the taken-over one at all. After the change below it compiles against go-wind-admin/pkg/localdeps/go-wind-toolkit/protoc-gen-go-redact/redact/v1, which is the package under takeover.
